author_notes: Native PC port by static recompilation. Supply your own Medal of Honor (Europe) disc (SLES-02470, Redump CUE/BIN); the USA, French and German discs are not supported. No BIOS dump is needed: the release bundles OpenBIOS (MIT). All 24 campaign levels load and run natively in the automated tests and Mission 1 was played through by hand on Windows; Linux and macOS packages are built by CI but untested by hand. Optional mod packages, off by default: mouse look and native 16:9 widescreen. The local split-screen multiplayer needs a second gamepad.
description: World War II first-person shooter by DreamWorks Interactive, recompiled natively for PC.
name: Medal of Honor (PAL)
notes: Prebuilt zips only (no local build block): CI builds the committed generated C. bios_identity is null because the packages ship OpenBIOS; the framework is pinned to upstream RetroPortingToolKit/psxrecomp. Disc digests are the Redump Track 01 values for Medal of Honor (Europe). Named PAL to tell it apart from FractalEngineer/Medal-Of-Honor-PSX-Recomp (USA disc, VR), which also calls itself Medal of Honor Recompiled.
